backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profiles, work inbox, tasks, content plans, channels, notes, and file metadata storage with per-user authorization and CRUD operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four implemented features related to replacing the animated gradient background with a Three.js 3D scene with rotating camera and theme-aware colors.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and utilities for onboarding, work inbox, planner, settings, PWA features, notifications, reminders, and file management.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind layers defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark themes, plus base styles for body and borders.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Persian language, PWA manifest link, theme color meta tags, and icon references for app installation.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining Persian business assistant app metadata including name, icons, display mode, orientation, and theme colors.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page in Persian with gradient background and retry button shown when network is unavailable.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for dynamic content, and offline page fallback with cache cleanup on activation.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, work inbox, tasks, planner, notes, files, settings, and onboarding, wrapped in ThemeProvider and AuthGate.
frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx: Main application shell component providing navigation sidebar, header with user menu, mobile responsive layout, and integrates service worker registration and reminders listener.
frontend/src/components/AuthGate.tsx: Authentication gate component that shows login screen for unauthenticated users, profile setup dialog for new users, and renders children for authenticated users with complete profiles.
frontend/src/components/CameraController: Three.js camera controller that creates smooth, non-repeating orbital motion with varying speeds and elevation for 3D scene visualization.
frontend/src/components/files/FileMetada: Dialog component for editing file metadata including file name and notes, with form validation and update mutation integration.
frontend/src/components/files/FileUpload: File upload dialog with drag-and-drop support, file preview, notes field, and handles file conversion to bytes for backend storage.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login screen component with Internet Identity authentication, featuring a 3D animated background and card layout displaying app features.
frontend/src/components/notes/NoteFormDi: Dialog component for creating and editing notes with title and content fields, using React Query mutations for add/update operations.
frontend/src/components/planner/ContentP: Dialog component for creating and editing content plans with fields for title, channel, content type, and status, integrating with channel profiles.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for initial user profile setup, collecting user name and saving profile data via mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallBanne: Banner component that prompts users to install the PWA, showing install/dismiss buttons or a success message if already installed.
frontend/src/components/reminders/Remind: Background component that fetches tasks and work items and passes them to the reminders hook for notification scheduling.
frontend/src/components/Scene3D.tsx: Three.js 3D scene component rendering animated torus knot and icosahedron geometries with dynamic lighting, materials, and theme-based colors.
frontend/src/components/settings/Channel: Dialog component for creating and editing channel profiles with fields for name, channel type, URL/handle, and notes.
Table view displaying all channel profiles with edit/delete actions and a button to add new channels, includes delete confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/settings/ImportE: Component providing export to JSON and import from JSON functionality for user data, including file metadata handling and confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Settings section for managing browser notification permissions with status display, permission request, and test notification functionality.
frontend/src/components/tasks/TaskFormDi: Dialog component for creating and editing tasks with fields for title and priority (1-3), using React Query mutations to add or update tasks via the backend actor.
Wrapper component that sets up React Three Fiber Canvas with Scene3D and CameraController for transparent 3D background rendering.
frontend/src/components/work-inbox/WorkI: Dialog component for creating and editing work inbox items with fields for description, source channel, and status, using React Query mutations and channel profiles from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, work inbox items, tasks, content plans, channel profiles, notes, and file management with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useThemeColors.ts: Custom hook that extracts CSS custom properties for theme colors, converts OKLCH color values to RGB hex format, and updates when the theme changes via MutationObserver.
frontend/src/index.css: Main stylesheet with Tailwind directives, CSS custom properties for light/dark theme colors (using oklch color space), RTL support, and 3D background container styles with reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/lib/fa.ts: Persian (Farsi) localization strings for the entire application, including navigation, actions, status labels, channels, and feature-specific translations for work inbox, tasks, planner, notes, files, and settings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/notifications/useNotificati: Custom React hook for managing browser notifications with permission requests, notification sending, and test notification functionality with RTL/Persian language support.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard overview page displaying summary cards for work inbox, tasks, content planner, and notes with counts and navigation to respective sections.
frontend/src/pages/FilesPage.tsx: File management page with upload, download, edit, and delete functionality, including search filtering, file metadata display in a table, and empty state handling.
frontend/src/pages/NotesPage.tsx: Notes management page with create, edit, delete, and copy functionality, displaying notes in a card grid with search filtering and empty state handling.
Multi-step onboarding wizard that guides users through adding their first channel profile and creating example tasks/notes, with skip option and RTL Persian UI.
frontend/src/pages/PlannerPage.tsx: Content planning page with tabs for upcoming/channel-grouped plans, CRUD operations via dialog, status badges, and empty state illustration.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page with sections for notifications, channel profiles, import/export, and a button to revisit onboarding wizard.
frontend/src/pages/TasksTodayPage.tsx: Task management page displaying incomplete and completed tasks with checkboxes, priority badges, edit/delete actions, and empty state.
frontend/src/pages/WorkInboxPage.tsx: Work inbox page with table view, search/filter by status and channel, CRUD operations via dialog, and status badges for work items.
frontend/src/pwa/registerServiceWorker.t: Registers service worker for PWA functionality, checks for updates every minute, and prompts user to reload when new version is available.
frontend/src/pwa/usePwaInstallPrompt.ts: React hook managing PWA install prompt state, detecting standalone mode, capturing beforeinstallprompt event, and providing install/dismiss functions.
frontend/src/reminders/useReminders.ts: React hook that checks tasks and work items every 5 minutes, showing browser notifications or toasts for overdue tasks and new work inbox items while persisting reminder state to localStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup capabilities.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH-based color system, custom animations, container settings, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features for replacing animated gradient background with Three.js 3D rotating scene using React Three Fiber with theme-aware OKLCH colors.
